INSERT INTO groups(
            group_id,
            state_encryption_key,
            my_group_private_key,
            group_name,
            joined_group
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
        ON CONFLICT(group_id) DO UPDATE SET
            state_encryption_key = excluded.state_encryption_key,
            my_group_private_key = excluded.my_group_private_key,
            left_group = 0,
            deleted_content = 0
